summary: Alim Saad Casad Abdulhamid, 38, an Islamic teacher from Buldon, Maguindanao del Norte, was shot by an unidentified gunman at the public market in Barangay Mataya at about 5:10 a.m. on Monday, 9 November 2026, and died at the scene. The gunman escaped before police and barangay watchmen arrived, and the Buldon police had not identified him or a motive. Philstar counted him the 9th Muslim preacher killed in the Bangsamoro region and Soccsksargen since January.
